name: ProductMediaGallery
description: Accessible PDP media gallery with one square viewing window, thumbnail selection, previous and next controls, and responsive rail placement.

ref.description: Exposes openPreview(imageId), which selects an existing image by stable ID and opens the enabled preview at the current breakpoint. Returns false without changing selection when unavailable, so source links can preserve native navigation.

images.description: Ordered product images with stable IDs, responsive-capable sources, and meaningful alt text.

defaultIndex.description: Initial active image index, clamped to the available image range.

galleryLabel.description: Localized accessible label for the gallery region.

thumbnailsLabel.description: Localized accessible label for the thumbnail control group.

previousLabel.description: Accessible name for the previous control.

nextLabel.description: Accessible name for the next control.

desktopPreview.description: Enables a full-viewport image dialog from 1024px with a left thumbnail column.

mobilePreview.description: Enables tap-to-preview below 1024px with a primary-surface background, swipeable large images, and one horizontally scrollable bottom thumbnail row; native gallery swiping is preserved.

openPreviewLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the main-image preview trigger.

closePreviewLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the preview close button.

onIndexChange.description: Reports native image scrolling, thumbnail, arrow button, and keyboard image changes.

focus.note: Thumbnail and navigation controls use the YAMI focus ring.

tapTarget.note: Thumbnail controls are at least 64px and navigation composes Button.

radius.note: The image stage, thumbnails, and counter consume semantic radius slots only.

motion.note: Hover changes surface color without shadows or geometry changes.

--space-200.property: desktop control inset; wide-mobile stage bleed and counter inset

--space-100.property: thumbnail and mobile image gap; counter inset; wide-mobile outer padding

accessibility.ariaPattern: labelled region containing a labelled thumbnail group, pressed-state buttons, and previous or next controls
accessibility.structure: The active product image retains meaningful alt text. Thumbnail images are decorative because each button announces position and image meaning.
accessibility.interaction: Native horizontal scrolling on mobile, thumbnail, previous, next, and ArrowLeft or ArrowRight selection all update the active image and polite counter. Opt-in previews use a native modal dialog, trap focus, and restore focus and scroll on close. Mobile preview has a single scrollable bottom thumbnail row. Escape closes the dialog; crossing into a disabled breakpoint also closes it.
